This is a research task - do NOT edit any files.

In the repo at C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\subagent-probe:

1. Read nollama.py and find ALL command-line flags defined via argparse `add_argument` calls. Extract the flag names exactly as defined (e.g. `--port`, `--device`, `-v`/`--verbose` style). Include both long and short forms if both exist for the same argument. List every single flag, including store_true flags, flags with default values, and positional arguments if any. Be thorough - read the entire argparse section of nollama.py, and search for all occurrences of `add_argument` in the file to make sure nothing is missed.

2. Then read docs/API.md and README.md and determine which of those flags are mentioned anywhere in those two files. A flag counts as "documented" if its exact flag string (e.g. `--port`) appears anywhere in either file. Check for each flag individually by searching both files for the flag string.

3. Return in your final message:
   - The complete list of all flags found in nollama.py (with the add_argument line numbers)
   - The list of flags NOT mentioned anywhere in docs/API.md or README.md (the undocumented flags)
   - Note any flags where the long/short form discrepancy exists (e.g. short form documented but long form not, or vice versa)

Be very thorough - this is the whole point of the task. Do not edit any file.
